sentences.display: Al-Ṭabarī gathered the opinions of the generations before him.
sentences.tts: Al-Tabari gathered the opinions of the generations before him.

sentences.display: Some said Iram was a city: Alexandria, according to one early authority; Damascus, according to another.
sentences.tts: Some said Ee-rahm was a city: Alexandria, according to one early authority; Damascus, according to another.

sentences.display: Some said it was a nation.
sentences.tts: Some said it was a nation.

sentences.display: Others said it was a clan of ʿĀd, "the royal house of ʿĀd", in the words of the early scholar Qatāda, or the name of their ancestor.
sentences.tts: Others said it was a clan of Aa-d, the royal house of Aa-d, in the words of the early scholar Qataada, or the name of their ancestor.
